title: Living with the jolts
odia: ଅଖ ବୁଲୁଥିଲେ ଚକ ବୁଲୁଥାଏ, ବୁଲି ପଡୁଥାଏ ମହି, ସଂସାର ଭିତରେ ଘର କରିଥିଲେ ପଥର ପଡ଼ିଲେ ସହି ।
literal_meaning: The axle turns, the wheel turns, the earth turns; having made a home in the world, endure even falling stones.
explanation: The movement of ordinary life leads into counsel to withstand hardship. Endurance is the proposed response to unavoidable jolts.
meaning_odia: ଅଖ ଓ ଚକର ଚଳଣି ସହ ଜୀବନର ଟାଣ ଓ କଷ୍ଟକୁ ମେଳାଯାଇଛି। ଚଳିବାକୁ ହେଲେ କିଛି ଅସୁବିଧା ସମ୍ଭାଳିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ—ଏହି ସହନଶୀଳତାର ଭାବ କଥାଟିରେ ଅଛି। ତେବେ ଏଡ଼ାଇହେବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ବା ନିର୍ଯାତନାକୁ ଜୀବନର ନିୟମ କହି ସହିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହାକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: After a storm delays a harvest, a family steadies itself and plans the remaining work. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Editorial interpretation of an unglossed verse. Endurance does not require accepting abuse or preventable harm.

witnesses.wording: ଅଖ ବୁଲୁଥିଲେ ଚକ ବୁଲୁଥାଏ, ବୁଲି ପଡୁଥାଏ ମହି, ସଂସାର ଭିତରେ ଘର କରିଥିଲେ ପଥର ପଡ଼ିଲେ ସହି ।

title: Imagine a horse with horns
odia: ଜାଣି ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଶିଙ୍ଗ ନାହିଁ, ଶିଙ୍ଗ ଥିଲେ ଘୋଡ଼ା ରଖନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ ।
literal_meaning: The horse has no horns; with horns it would spare no one.
explanation: The image starts with an already powerful animal and imagines giving it another weapon. The collection explains the line as a limit on the strength granted to the strong: with still more power, they might heed nobody. The humour is in the impossible extra equipment, not in a claim that real horses are naturally malicious.
meaning_odia: ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଜୋର ତ ଅଛି; ସେଥିରେ ଯଦି ଶିଙ୍ଗ ବି ଥାଆନ୍ତା! ଏହି ଅସମ୍ଭବ ଛବିରେ ଢଗଟି ଶକ୍ତିର ସୀମାକୁ ଦେଖାଏ। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଅନୁସାରେ ବଳୁଆକୁ ଆହୁରି ବଳ ମିଳିଲେ ସେ କାହାକୁ ଖାତିର ନକରିପାରେ। ଘୋଡ଼ାର ସ୍ୱଭାବ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରିବା ଏହାର କଥା ନୁହେଁ; ମଣିଷର ଅସୀମ କ୍ଷମତାକୁ ନେଇ ପରିହାସ।
usage_example: A forceful committee member asks to control both the funds and every decision. Another member jokes about adding horns to the horse. (Original imagined example.)
cultural_context: The supplied gloss invokes divine restraint; this is the collection’s explanation, not evidence for a particular myth or author. The last clause’s omitted object is rendered “no one” in English in line with the gloss’s reference to heeding nobody. The opening ଜାଣି does not securely establish who knows or intends this; the English does not turn it into an imperative. Its agency remains unresolved.
odia_summary: ଆଗରୁ ବଳୁଆ ଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ଆହୁରି ଅସୀମ କ୍ଷମତା ଦେବାର ପରିହାସ।
english_summary: The imaginary horns expose the danger of unchecked power.

title: An ant guarding the jaggery
literal_meaning: An ant as the guard of the jaggery store.
explanation: The supposed guard has an appetite for exactly what it must protect. The dictionary uses this mismatch for entrusting something to its would-be consumer: the arrangement itself puts the goods at risk. In conversation, the image can make a questionable appointment look absurd before anyone has to explain it at length. It questions a particular conflict between duty and temptation, rather than declaring that a whole kind of person is dishonest.
meaning_odia: ଯାହାକୁ ଜଗିବାକୁ ଦିଆଗଲା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେହି ଜିନିଷ ଉପରେ—ଚିତ୍ରଟିର ମଜା ଏଇଠି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ତାହାର ଖାଦକ ଜିମାରେ ଦେବାର ଅସଙ୍ଗତି ବୁଝାଇଛି। କୌଣସି ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଦେବା ବେଳେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଓ ନିଜର ଲୋଭ ମୁହାଁମୁହିଁ ହେଉଥିଲେ, ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଚିତ୍ର ବଡ଼ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ବିନା କଥାଟି ଧରାଇଦିଏ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ସେହି ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ନେଇ, କୌଣସି ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ଜନ୍ମରୁ ଅସାଧୁ କହିବାକୁ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: A guard tempted to consume the very thing entrusted to them.
odia_summary: ଯାହାକୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା କଥା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେଇଠି।
usage_example: A club puts its snack box in the charge of the member who keeps finishing the biscuits before meetings. Another member laughs, “ଗୁଡ଼ଘରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଜଗୁଆଳି!” They agree to keep the box available only when everyone arrives. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: The source explicitly explains entrusting food to its consumer. Modern organizational use is editorial extension, not documented origin. Parenthetical ପରିଛା is an alternative guard term in the source, not a new saying.

odia: ଯାହାଁ ଯାହାଁ ବୁଢ଼ା, ତାହଁ ତାହାଁ ବେକୁବ୍
title: A verdict made from age
literal_meaning: Wherever there are old people, there are fools.
explanation: The repeated “wherever…there” makes age stand in for judgment. Our critical reading questions that shortcut: a person’s age cannot tell us whether a particular remark is foolish. The source preserves the insult, not this objection to it. Its sweeping rhythm can make the verdict sound settled before any individual has been heard.
meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁଠି ସେଇଠିର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ବୟସକୁ ବିଚାରର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ବସାଏ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ଏହି ସହଜ ରାୟକୁ ପଚାରେ—ବୟସରୁ କାହାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କଥା ନିର୍ବୋଧ କି ନୁହେଁ ଜଣାଯାଏନାହିଁ। ଉତ୍ସ ଅପମାନଟି ରଖିଛି, ତାହା ପ୍ରତି ଆମର ଆପତ୍ତି ନୁହେଁ। ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ କଥା ଶୁଣିବା ଆଗରୁ ହିଁ ଛନ୍ଦର ଜୋର ରାୟକୁ ସ୍ଥିର ଭଳି ଶୁଣାଇପାରେ।
english_summary: Our critical reading challenges a sweeping insult that substitutes age for judgment.
odia_summary: ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ କଥା ବଦଳରେ ବୟସରେ ରାୟ ଦେବାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପଚାରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading group, someone quotes the line after discussing a disagreement between generations. Another asks them to examine the disputed suggestion itself rather than the speaker’s age. This imagined response challenges the generalization; it is not a traditional reply supplied by the source.
cultural_context: A documented age-directed taunt, not evidence about cognition or the beliefs of every community. Our rejection of its blanket judgment is explicitly editorial.

odia: ପୋଡ଼ି ଯାଉ ଏ ଯୁଗର ରୀତି, ଅଜା ଥାଉଁ ଥାଉଁ ମରଇ ନାତି
title: A lament against the times
literal_meaning: Let the ways of this age burn: while the grandfather is still alive, the grandson dies.
explanation: The curse against the age is followed by a death that reverses the expected generational order. Our reading hears grief protesting that reversal. The line names no cause or particular family, and its anger at “the times” is not evidence that an era caused the death.
meaning_odia: ଯୁଗକୁ ଅଭିଶାପ ଦେବା ପରେ ଏମିତି ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ଆସେ ଯାହା ପିଢ଼ିର ଆଶାକରା କ୍ରମକୁ ଓଲଟାଇ ଦିଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଶୋକ ସେ ଓଲଟାଣିକୁ ପ୍ରତିବାଦ କରୁଥିବା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। କଥାଟି କୌଣସି କାରଣ ବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିବାରର ନାମ ଦିଏନାହିଁ; “ଯୁଗ” ପ୍ରତି ରାଗ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର କାରଣ ଯୁଗ ଥିଲା ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our reading hears grief resisting an expected order overturned.
odia_summary: ଆଶାକରା କ୍ରମ ଓଲଟିଗଲେ ଶୋକର ପ୍ରତିବାଦକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଶୁଣେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ପାଠ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଯୁଗକୁ କାହିଁକି ଦୋଷ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ହୁଏତ କାରଣ ବୁଝାଇବାଠାରୁ ଦୁଃଖକୁ କହିବା ଏଠି ମୁଖ୍ୟ।” / A reading group asks why the age is blamed. Someone suggests that expressing grief may matter more here than explaining a cause. This discussion is invented, not testimony from a bereaved family.
cultural_context: The dictionary supplies the phrase “spirit of the age.” No historical mortality pattern, named death or literal call to burn anything is established.
